# Code of conduct

Topping Out is a small project run by one person. Everyone who opens an issue, a pull request or a discussion here is welcome, whatever their background or experience.

## What we expect

- Be kind and assume good faith. Most problems are misunderstandings.
- Criticise the work, not the person. "This breaks on macOS because..." helps; "this is rubbish" doesn't.
- Back a claim with something others can check: a command, its output, a commit.
- Accept that a no is sometimes the answer, and say why when you give one.

## What is not okay

- Harassment, insults, or personal or political attacks.
- Sexual language or imagery, or unwelcome attention of any kind.
- Publishing someone's private information without their permission.
- Anything else a reasonable person would see as unwelcome here.

## If something goes wrong

Email kai.thoughtarchitect@gmail.com. Reports are read in confidence. The maintainer may edit or remove comments, close issues or pull requests, or block anyone who breaks this code, and will say why when it's safe to.

This applies in the repo and anywhere someone is representing the project.

Adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version 2.1.
